review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for the frozen C input. DEC-001=OPT-1 is explicitly a benchmark hypothetical, not a human-confirmed Decision; the empty decision input is therefore consistent, and only the selected branch is required. This does not waive the decisions-stage block required for an unresolved material DEC-001 in paired B. REQ-001, AC-001 through AC-003, task keys, repository identity/base commit, evidence stages and exact writable scopes agree with the original PRD. The supplied source places normalization, vocabulary sets and truthy-first decoding in core/api.ts, with classic and mini forwarding to that shared factory. Thus the implementation file and both regression files form an appropriate writable binding; the forwarding and declaration consumers remain inspection owners. The build configuration supports treating emitted declarations as generated rather than separately maintained owners. Boundary and compatibility expectations preserve existing case normalization, no-trim behavior, non-overlapping vocabularies, boolean inference and encode/decode behavior. TASK-VERIFY is independently assigned and depends on TASK-IMPLEMENT, with both roles required to cover every mandatory AC. The allowed implementer and verifier have active project-scoped trusted claims for the bounded contract, TypeScript, failure-handling, automation and data-change scope; the verifier additionally has testing.verification. Pending legacy claims and personas are not needed to establish eligibility. A distinct configured reviewer supplies the non-executing review prerequisite. Expected planning readiness is therefore supported and does not authorize task dispatch or repository changes. Gold and preview release fingerprints agree, and the supplied provenance explains the distinct manifest/evaluation source digest domains and PRD persistence normalization. Historical operations are retained as old-version history, not fresh candidate evidence. No candidate outputs were used. I reviewed the supplied text and Service-bound fingerprint evidence only; I did not execute code, independently recompute digests or provide human attestation.
